evidence: The TEM imaging of the samples was performed using a JEOL 2010F 200 kV Schottky field emission transmission electron microscope equipped with an Oxford energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) system for elemental analysis while imaging. Cross-sectional surface of the HDPE/Al2O3 nanocomposites was observed by field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) and TEM. FESEM images were taken by a JEOL JSM-7401F FESEM. Cross-sectional TEM samples were prepared by cutting an epoxy resin cured composite film at −100°C using a diamond knife and the thickness of the TEM sample was approximately 100 nm.
